links.outcome: Readability of LLM depression responses (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across LLMs; DeepSeek and Google Gemini performed less favorably than ChatGPT-4.0 (p < 0.05).
links.quote: Significant differences in readability scores were observed, with DeepSeek and Google Gemini performing less favorably compared with ChatGPT-4.0 (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of responses from four commercial LLMs to depression-related questions without testing any specific guardrail or deployment practice.
